title: Face a Maniac that bets and raises where TAG would check or call
description:
As a learner, I want Maniac opponents that play far too aggressively, so that I learn to call down and re-raise against loose-aggressive players.

Maniac (loose-aggressive) is built on the advice evaluation with documented deviations stored in its own style data file: where the advice is check it bets more often than TAG, and where the advice is call it raises more often than TAG. When the street is capped a raise is impossible and the Maniac calls. Deviation choices use the seeded generator from E06-S02. Target band (proved in E06-S09): VPIP 50-75%, PFR 35-60%, aggression 65-85%.

## Requirements covered
- REQ-026 (Must): Bots built on the advice engine — Each bot shall choose its action from the advice engine's evaluation of its own view of the game, modified by its style's documented parameters.

Covers: REQ-026

Plan key: E06-S04 · Dream: limit-holdem-trainer

acceptanceCriteria.text: Given the Maniac style data file, When it is loaded, Then it holds the style's deviation parameters and a plain-English description of the style [REQ-026.3]
Given 10,000 seeded decision points with no bet to face where the advice is check, When a Maniac and a TAG each act at the same points, Then the Maniac bets at more of them than TAG [REQ-026.2]
Given 10,000 seeded decision points where the advice is call, When a Maniac and a TAG each act at the same points, Then the Maniac raises at more of them than TAG [REQ-026.2]
Given the Maniac file's raise probability is changed and no code is changed, When the same 10,000 seeded decision points are replayed, Then its raise rate changes [REQ-026.3]
Given a Maniac facing a bet on a capped street (one bet and three raises made), When it chooses to be aggressive, Then it calls and the action is legal [REQ-026.2]
